row.name: custodial_lots_property_unique
row.where: "normalized_property_number" IS NOT NULL AND "property_exception_id" IS NULL

row.name: custodial_lots_property_fields
row.value: ("property_number" IS NULL AND "normalized_property_number" IS NULL AND "property_exception_id" IS NULL) OR ("property_number" IS NOT NULL AND "normalized_property_number" IS NOT NULL AND length(trim("property_number")) > 0 AND length(trim("normalized_property_number")) > 0)

row.name: custodial_sections_dates
row.value: "effective_until" IS NULL OR "effective_from" IS NULL OR "effective_until" >= "effective_from"
